work.description: Brief XLI to Bailiff Carlo Candida (address LF7970–7972) derogates from the Hospitaller statutes so that the pope’s nephew Giovanni Antonio Cappellari may be received as a knight of justice; speck LF7975 excluded; LF8026 → LF8035 across speck LF8029 (raw heading line-00008029) and running title LF8032; complete 16 June 1835 closing. Own provenance LF8102 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7976–7976; the source closing at LF8057–8060 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima sexta iunii mille- simo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
